label: Время
description: Twelve-mission case drill for время (time) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form время is the subject of the sentence. This is a neuter noun ending in -мя, a small irregular class that keeps the bare stem only in the nominative and accusative singular and inserts a hidden -ен- segment elsewhere.

missions.phrase: У меня нет времени на отдых.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The negation нет requires the genitive, and время expands to времени. This is the -ен- insert characteristic of -мя neuters: the hidden segment surfaces and takes the ending -и.

Strategic focus: Dative singular. The noun takes the dative времени as the indirect target here, a form identical to the genitive. The dative rests on the -ен- expanded stem времен-, the insert that defines this irregular neuter.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. As the direct object of тратим the noun returns to the bare form время. Accusative singular is one of the two slots where a -мя neuter keeps the unexpanded stem and shows no -ен- insert.

Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The phrase со временем (with time, eventually) uses the instrumental. The neuter instrumental ending -ем attaches to the -ен- expanded stem, producing временем — the irregular insert plus the regular neuter ending.

missions.phrase: Расскажите о времени и месте встречи.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The preposition о (about) requires the prepositional case, giving времени. Built on the -ен- expanded stem, it coincides with the genitive and dative, so all three singular oblique forms read времени.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject takes времена. The -ен- insert remains, and the neuter plural ending -а attaches to the expanded stem, giving the irregular времена with a stress shift to the ending.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. Possession plus the plural sense forces the genitive plural времён. The -ен- expanded stem takes a zero ending here with ё, yielding the irregular времён.

Strategic focus: Dative plural. The preposition по governs the dative, here the plural временам in the sense of at times. The dative plural ending -ам rests on the -ен- expanded stem, keeping the insert visible across the plural.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. As the direct object of изучают the inanimate noun copies the nominative plural, giving времена. The accusative equals the nominative for this inanimate neuter, both built on the -ен- expanded stem.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The preposition между selects the instrumental plural временами. The ending -ами attaches to the -ен- expanded stem, so the irregular insert carries through this form too.

missions.phrase: В прежних временах было больше тишины.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The preposition в (in) marks the prepositional plural временах. Like every plural form, it sits on the -ен- expanded stem, the insert that marks время as a -мя irregular neuter.
